calls.statement:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl,
 MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at),
 SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM q

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) sl, MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date),
 SUM(CASE WHEN sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullsl,
 SUM(CASE WHEN sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory, cp.category AS cur_cat, p.category AS asof_cat, p.subcategory AS asof_sub, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cur_cat, subcategory, asof_cat, asof_sub, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(sold.net_amount) sold_net, SUM(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  COUNT(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines
FROM sold LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
WHERE cur_cat='Garden' OR asof_cat='Garden' OR subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' OR asof_sub='Outdoor Lighting'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, sold.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS refund_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sold.subcategory ORDER BY sold.subcategory
